title: View: Scrollable list (virtual scrolling for large directories)
acceptance_criteria: Virtual scrolling: only visible rows rendered (not all entries)
Scroll offset tracked and updated on mouse wheel / scrollbar drag
Scrollbar thumb size proportional to visible/total ratio
Scrollbar thumb position reflects current scroll offset
Keyboard arrow keys scroll list by one row
Page Up / Page Down scroll by one page (visible rows count)
Home / End keys jump to first / last entry
Performance: 10,000 entries scroll smoothly at 60 FPS
